Digital sales represent food and beverage revenue for company-owned restaurants generated through the Chipotle website, Chipotle app or third-party delivery aggregators and include revenue deferrals associated with Chipotle Rewards. Digital sales represented 36.7% of food and beverage revenue in 2025, compared to 35.1% in 2024. We have made digital ordering convenient with continued enhancements to our app and by building more Chipotlanes, which is our drive through format for guest pick-up of digital orders. marks.claim: In the third quarter of 2026, Chipotle reported total revenue of $3.3 billion, an increase of 9.6% year-over-year, driven by new restaurant openings and comparable sales [release line 00018]. The company also saw improvements in food, beverage, and packaging costs as a percentage of total revenue, decreasing to 29.5% from 30.0% in the third quarter of 2025, primarily due to menu price increases and tariff relief [release line 00029].
